post.summary: Stage one purpose-bound Exam Resource upload for a live Sitting correction
post.description: The multipart body contains metadata first and content second. A successful response exposes only authoritative ready-stage metadata; storage and lease identities remain private.

post.summary: Create an immutable live correction and retarget one open or paused Sitting
post.description: Resources is the complete desired ordered manifest. Omission removes an existing resource, array order becomes resource position, an item without stage_id retains its base content, and an item with stage_id selects that ready purpose-bound stage. Omitted instructions_markdown preserves the current instructions; a present empty string clears them. Policy, Starter Workspace, future default, and schedule cannot be changed here.

bearerAuth.description: A Proctor session access credential or Personal Access Token, subject to the route's x-proctor-auth requirement.

sessionCookie.name: PROCTOR_ACCESS
sessionCookie.description: The host-only HttpOnly browser session access cookie.

csrfToken.name: X-Proctor-CSRF-Token
csrfToken.description: Required with the session cookie for state-changing requests.

refreshBearerAuth.description: A refresh credential accepted only by the refresh operation.

refreshCookie.name: PROCTOR_REFRESH
refreshCookie.description: The host-only HttpOnly browser refresh cookie.

OptionalIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
OptionalIdempotencyKey.description: Opaque client key. Identical semantic commands replay the committed outcome for at least 24 hours; reuse with different input is a conflict.

RequiredIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
RequiredIdempotencyKey.description: Required opaque client key. Identical semantic commands replay the committed outcome for at least 24 hours; reuse with different input is a conflict.

CandidateAttemptCredential.name: X-Proctor-Attempt-Credential
CandidateAttemptCredential.description: Sensitive canonical 32-byte Raw URL-safe base64 continuity credential for the active Participation. Never log, persist, cache, or place this value in a URL.

CandidateAttemptConnectionID.name: X-Proctor-Attempt-Connection-ID
CandidateAttemptConnectionID.description: The durable open Attempt Connection bound to the current authenticated Session.

CandidateWorkspaceFileUploadMultipart.description: Exactly two parts in order: strict JSON metadata first, then bounded file content. The complete request is limited to 10 MiB plus 64 KiB.

ExamSittingCorrectionResourceStageMetada.description: For addition, replaces_resource_id must be omitted. For replacement, it is required and identifies a resource in the exact base Revision.

ExamSittingCorrectionResourceStageMultip.description: Exactly two parts in order: metadata first as a non-file JSON part (maximum 32768 bytes), then content. The complete HTTP body is limited to 10 MiB plus 64 KiB multipart overhead.

ExamSittingCorrectionResourceRequest.description: An item without stage_id retains the exact base content. An item with stage_id selects the ready stage bound to this resource and correction target.

title.description: Omitted or null leaves the title unchanged; a present value is trimmed and must remain non-empty.

StarterWorkspacePath.description: An already-canonical, case-sensitive POSIX-relative path: at most 16 segments and 255 UTF-8 bytes per segment. Empty, absolute, dot, dot-dot, repeated/trailing separators, backslashes, NUL/control characters, and the reserved .proctor root are rejected.
